meta.nhieu: MIT-BIH NSTDB (Moody 1984) bw/em/ma, kenh noise1 (cot 0), 360 Hz -> 1000 Hz resample_poly(25, 9); mix = tong ba loai sau khi chuan hoa moi loai ve phuong sai don vi
meta.dinh_nghia_snr: SNR_dB = 10*log10(P_signal/P_noise); P_signal = phuong sai cua tin hieu bung THO 1000 Hz tren toan ban ghi (gom ECG me ap dao + ECG thai + nhieu san co); P_noise = phuong sai doan nhieu cong vao; y = s + a*(n-mean(n)), a = sqrt(P_signal/(P_noise*10^(SNR/10))). SNR so voi TOAN BO tin hieu bung, khong phai so voi rieng thanh phan thai.
meta.doan_nhieu: offset ngau nhien, rng = default_rng([SEED=0, chi_so_ban_ghi, kenh, chi_so_loai]); cung offset cho moi SNR; moi kenh mot doan doc lap
meta.mo_hinh: checkpoint fold_rXX (rXX ngoai train/val), nguong tu checkpoint (chon tren ban ghi val cua fold); M.preprocess -> M.cancel_maternal -> robust_scale -> M.probability_series -> M.pick_peaks
meta.cham: +/-50 ms tai 1000 Hz, ghep 1-1 tham lam M.match_events; macro F1 = TB 20 (ban ghi x kenh)
meta.kenh_psd: benchmark_dpss/blind_lead.pick_blind tren phan du cua tung phuong phap trong DIEU KIEN NHIEU do
